objective: Find source-intrinsic reasons for the proposed three indexed particle-candidate paths, rather than assigning an arbitrary tag mode after the fact.
governing_conjecture: The actual ordered local/alignment projector pair has a natural structural distinction: proton/neutron are dual incomparable pairs while electron alignment is already the return. This may explain an absorbing intermediate role, but must be separated from a natural physical sector/handoff law.

naturality_scope.base_object: An ordered pair of commuting metric-orthogonal projections L,G on the retained raw source, N=LG.
naturality_scope.frame_changes: Simultaneous invertible coefficient-frame changes with the metric transported; not assertions of native physical actuator availability.
naturality_scope.active_packet: Image(N) with the restricted native L/G operations, metric and source recovery.
naturality_scope.full_preparation_interface: Also retain L/G readers on arbitrary raw inputs. This is a strictly richer task than the active packet alone.
naturality_scope.spectator_test: A dormant G-only direction can be irrelevant to active return readers while changing the full preparation task. Do not silently declare the two tasks equivalent.
naturality_scope.omissions: This iteration does not claim that projector-pair data contain all geometric incidences, ordered corners or native generator words. A pair-only no-go does not settle that richer source.

predictions.joint_sectors: Q11=N, Q10=L-N, Q01=G-N, Q00=I-L-G+N are orthogonal joint sectors. Their dimensions in this order are proton(1,11,2,22), neutron(1,2,11,22), electron(2,2,0,4).
predictions.redundancy: Only electron satisfies G=N, so its local constraint can be omitted for the endpoint task on the entire raw input space. Both baryons have nonzero G-only and L-only witnesses; neither stage alone suffices.
predictions.duality: Swapping L and G exchanges the two baryon joint signatures. This is coarse pair-structure duality, not an identification of their full geometric/generator sources.
predictions.pair_algebra: Every element of the algebra generated only by I,L,G restricts to a scalar on Image(N). The pair alone cannot supply a nontrivial internal sector swap there.
predictions.automorphisms: The actual electron return admits two noncommuting metric-unitary automorphisms commuting with L and G. Their logical commutant is scalar, excluding a natural nontrivial rank-one M/C partition of the doublet from pair data alone.
predictions.classifier_nonuniqueness: The frame-natural predicates b_nest=[G=N] and b_rank=[rank(N)>1] both fit proton/neutron/electron modes0/0/1. A declared alignment enlargement by one dormant G-only direction keeps N and rank(N) fixed but makes these predicates disagree. Adding the whole dormant sector instead preserves all24 native combined face/spin symmetries and still makes them disagree.
predictions.reader_boundary: That enlargement is active-return equivalent but not full-preparation equivalent: the selected dormant input has Gv=0 and G'v=v. This obstructs descent to active-only packet identity, not use of full source context.
predictions.genericity: The commuting-projector axioms admit equal, both nesting orientations and incomparable examples with nonzero return. They do not select exactly three physical species.

named_rivals: The prior handoff bit is uniquely determined by a return-rank fingerprint
G=N directly proves the electron two-cycle
An intrinsic nontrivial M/C split of the active doublet comes from L/G alone
A dormant-source countermodel is automatically the same full-reader task
Projector-pair duality proves full proton/neutron identity
next_executable_scope: Test which actual geometric incidences, ordered local-mode records and native generator words survive the pair-only automorphisms and can select a stage/sector interface. Those source records already exist; this is not a missing-source waiting leaf.
